description: This file defines the class EditSmartViewModalController, which manages the state and behavior of a modal dialog for editing 'SmartView' objects within a web application. It includes methods for setting properties, validating JSON predicates, saving changes, and deleting views.

classes.name: EditSmartViewModalController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the editing of SmartView objects within a modal dialog, including state management, validation, and persistence.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title property of the controller.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon property of the controller.

methods.name: setIsPredicateJsonValid
methods.description: Sets the validity state of the predicate JSON.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Assigns a SmartView object to the controller and updates related properties.

methods.name: setIsSaving
methods.description: Sets the isSaving flag indicating save operation status.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Resets the controller state and closes the modal dialog.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates, saves changes to the SmartView, and closes the dialog.

methods.name: deleteView
methods.description: Deletes the current SmartView after user confirmation.

methods.name: validateAndPrettifyCustomPredicate
methods.description: Validates the predicate JSON and formats it for readability.
